description: Potentiel photovoltaïque des toitures - Isère - 2024-2025 is a dataset listed in Opendata Isère open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. Ce jeu de données géographiques qualifie le potentiel photovoltaïque des toitures de structures bâties en Isère (hors Grenoble Alpes Métropole) Les données sont produites dans le cadre du dispositif Pack Solaire du Département de l'Isère, l'offre de services aux communes et EPCI permettant de dynamiser l’installation de projets photovoltaïques sur les toitures ou ombrières de ... Coverage: Isère. The portal files it under Développement du territoire. Its keywords are solaire, toiture, photovoltaique, potentiel solaire, Isère, bâtiment. The portal shows 2025-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-isere-fr-portal.
